%% ===================================================================
%%  Dungeons & Dragons 2024 character sheet -- LaTeX re-creation
%%  LAYOUT FILE -- do not edit.  Your character lives in character.tex.
%%
%%  Build with:  ./make.sh      (or: pdflatex -jobname=character-sheet layout.tex)
%%
%%  This file reads character.tex, and every value it finds there is optional:
%%  a key that is absent prints a blank field in the sheet.
%% ===================================================================
\documentclass[10pt]{article}

\usepackage[paperwidth=603bp,paperheight=774bp,margin=0pt]{geometry}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[sfdefault]{cabin}     % stand-in for Scala Sans
\usepackage{cinzel}               % stand-in display face for the wordmark
\usepackage{microtype}            % provides \textls* letterspacing
\usepackage{textcomp}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\usepackage{tikz}

\pagestyle{empty}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\topskip}{0pt}
\setlength{\abovedisplayskip}{0pt}

%% ------------------------------------------------------------------
%%  Palette -- sampled from the original
%% ------------------------------------------------------------------
\definecolor{dndInk}     {RGB}{ 35, 31, 32}   % headings and rules
\definecolor{dndLabel}   {RGB}{109,110,113}   % small column labels
\definecolor{dndFaint}   {RGB}{147,149,152}   % C / R / M and coin labels
\definecolor{dndGridA}   {RGB}{199,200,202}   % graph paper, fine
\definecolor{dndGridB}   {RGB}{177,179,182}   % fill-in rules
\definecolor{dndGridC}   {RGB}{209,211,212}
\definecolor{dndGridD}   {RGB}{157,159,162}
\definecolor{dndFrame}   {RGB}{162,164,167}   % the frame bands
\definecolor{dndPaper}   {RGB}{233,234,235}   % page tint behind the frames
\definecolor{dndFill}    {RGB}{ 26, 41,105}   % your handwriting-in-ink colour

%% Font used for everything you fill in.
\newcommand{\dndfillfont}{\sffamily\fontsize{8.5}{9.5}\selectfont}
\newcommand{\dndfillfontsmall}{\sffamily\fontsize{7}{8}\selectfont}


%% ------------------------------------------------------------------
%%  The commands character.tex is allowed to use.
%%
%%    \dndset{key}{value}        write a value into a named box
%%    \dndprof{key,key,...}      blacken proficiency rings / tick boxes
%%    \dndexpertise{key,...}     mark skill expertise with a bullseye
%%    \dndweapon{name}{atk}{damage}{notes}             one per row, max 6
%%    \dndspell{lvl}{name}{time}{range}{C,R,M}{notes}  one per row, max 30
%%    \dndink{colour}            colour of everything you fill in
%% ------------------------------------------------------------------
\makeatletter
\newcommand{\dndset}[2]{\expandafter\gdef\csname dnd@v@#1\endcsname{#2}}
\newcommand{\dndink}[1]{\colorlet{dndFill}{#1}}
\newcommand{\dnd@mark}[1]{\expandafter\gdef\csname dnd@p@#1\endcsname{1}}
\newcommand{\dndprof}[1]{\forcsvlist{\dnd@mark}{#1}}
\newcommand{\dnd@expertmark}[1]{\dnd@mark{#1}%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname dnd@e@#1\endcsname{1}}
\newcommand{\dndexpertise}[1]{\forcsvlist{\dnd@expertmark}{#1}}

\newcounter{dnd@wrow}
\newcommand{\dndweapon}[4]{\stepcounter{dnd@wrow}%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname dnd@w\the\value{dnd@wrow}@a\endcsname{#1}%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname dnd@w\the\value{dnd@wrow}@b\endcsname{#2}%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname dnd@w\the\value{dnd@wrow}@c\endcsname{#3}%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname dnd@w\the\value{dnd@wrow}@d\endcsname{#4}}

\newcounter{dnd@srow}
\newcommand{\dndspell}[6]{\stepcounter{dnd@srow}%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname dnd@s\the\value{dnd@srow}@a\endcsname{#1}%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname dnd@s\the\value{dnd@srow}@b\endcsname{#2}%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname dnd@s\the\value{dnd@srow}@c\endcsname{#3}%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname dnd@s\the\value{dnd@srow}@d\endcsname{#4}%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname dnd@s\the\value{dnd@srow}@e\endcsname{#5}%
  \expandafter\gdef\csname dnd@s\the\value{dnd@srow}@f\endcsname{#6}}
\makeatother


%% ------------------------------------------------------------------
%%  Read the character.  Missing file -> a blank sheet, not an error.
%% ------------------------------------------------------------------
\IfFileExists{character.tex}{\input{character.tex}}{%
  \GenericWarning{}{No character.tex found -- printing a blank sheet}}


%% ------------------------------------------------------------------
%%  INTERNALS -- nothing below here needs editing.
%% ------------------------------------------------------------------
\makeatletter

%% ---- shrink-to-fit box ----
\newsavebox{\dnd@bx}
\newcommand{\dnd@fit}[2]{%
  \sbox\dnd@bx{#2}%
  \ifdim\wd\dnd@bx>#1\relax\resizebox{#1}{!}{\usebox\dnd@bx}\else\usebox\dnd@bx\fi}

%% ---- static sheet labels ----
%% \dndT{x}{y}{size}{colour}{tracking}{content} -- baseline, left aligned
\newcommand{\dndT}[6]{%
  \node[anchor=base west,text=#4,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt] at (#1,#2)
    {\fontsize{#3}{#3}\selectfont\textls*[#5]{#6}};}
%% \dndTC{x}{y}{size}{colour}{content} -- baseline, centred on x
\newcommand{\dndTC}[5]{%
  \node[anchor=base,text=#4,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt] at (#1,#2)
    {\fontsize{#3}{#3}\selectfont #5};}

%% ---- filled-in values ----
%% \dndFL{key}{x}{y}{width} -- left aligned on the baseline y
\newcommand{\dndFL}[4]{\ifcsname dnd@v@#1\endcsname
  \node[anchor=base west,text=dndFill,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt] at (#2,#3)
    {\dndfillfont\dnd@fit{#4}{\csname dnd@v@#1\endcsname}};\fi}
%% \dndFC{key}{x}{y}{width} -- centred on x, sitting on the baseline y
\newcommand{\dndFC}[4]{\ifcsname dnd@v@#1\endcsname
  \node[anchor=base,text=dndFill,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt] at (#2,#3)
    {\dndfillfont\dnd@fit{#4}{\csname dnd@v@#1\endcsname}};\fi}
%% \dndFM{key}{x}{y}{width} -- centred on the point in both axes
\newcommand{\dndFM}[4]{\ifcsname dnd@v@#1\endcsname
  \node[anchor=center,text=dndFill,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt] at (#2,#3)
    {\dndfillfont\dnd@fit{#4}{\csname dnd@v@#1\endcsname}};\fi}
%% \dndFP{key}{x}{y}{width}{height} -- paragraph, top-left corner at (x,y)
%% #5 is the height of the panel; it is not needed for typesetting but is
%% kept so the call documents how much room the panel actually has.
\newcommand{\dndFP}[5]{\ifcsname dnd@v@#1\endcsname
  \node[anchor=north west,text=dndFill,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt,
        text width=#4,align=flush left]
    at (#2,#3) {\dndfillfontsmall\csname dnd@v@#1\endcsname\par};\fi}
%% small centred value used inside table rows
\newcommand{\dndFR}[4]{\ifcsname #1\endcsname
  \node[anchor=base west,text=dndFill,inner sep=0pt,outer sep=0pt] at (#2,#3)
    {\dndfillfontsmall\dnd@fit{#4}{\csname #1\endcsname}};\fi}

%% ---- marks ----
%% \dndRing{key}{x}{y}{radius} -- proficiency dot or expertise bullseye
\newcommand{\dndRing}[4]{%
  \ifcsname dnd@e@#1\endcsname
    \path[fill=dndInk] (#2,#3) circle[radius=#4bp];%
    \path[fill=white] (#2,#3) circle[radius={0.70*#4bp}];%
    \path[fill=dndInk] (#2,#3) circle[radius={0.32*#4bp}];%
  \else
    \ifcsname dnd@p@#1\endcsname
      \path[fill=dndInk] (#2,#3) circle[radius=#4bp];%
    \fi
  \fi}
%% a four-pointed star, drawn to match the sheet's own diamond glyph
\newcommand{\dnd@dia}[3]{%
  \path[fill=dndInk] (#1,#2)
    ++(0,-0.5*#3) .. controls ++(0.10*#3,0.22*#3) and ++(-0.22*#3,-0.10*#3) ..
      ++(0.5*#3,0.5*#3) .. controls ++(0.22*#3,0.10*#3) and ++(-0.10*#3,-0.22*#3) ..
      ++(-0.5*#3,0.5*#3) .. controls ++(-0.10*#3,-0.22*#3) and ++(0.22*#3,0.10*#3) ..
      ++(-0.5*#3,-0.5*#3) .. controls ++(-0.22*#3,-0.10*#3) and ++(0.10*#3,0.22*#3) ..
      cycle;}
%% \dndDiaFlag{key}{x}{y}{size} -- fill this diamond if the flag is set
\newcommand{\dndDiaFlag}[4]{\ifcsname dnd@p@#1\endcsname\dnd@dia{#2}{#3}{#4}\fi}
%% \dndDiaN{key}{index}{x}{y}{size} -- fill if the stored count reaches index
\newcommand{\dndDiaN}[5]{\ifcsname dnd@v@#1\endcsname
  \ifnum\csname dnd@v@#1\endcsname>\numexpr#2-1\relax\dnd@dia{#3}{#4}{#5}\fi\fi}

%% ---- repeating table rows ----
%% \dndWeapon{row}{baseline}
\newcommand{\dndWeapon}[2]{%
  \dndFR{dnd@w#1@a}{228.9}{#2}{100bp}%
  \dndFR{dnd@w#1@b}{337.4}{#2}{41bp}%
  \dndFR{dnd@w#1@c}{385.0}{#2}{71bp}%
  \dndFR{dnd@w#1@d}{462.8}{#2}{121bp}}
%% \dndSpell{row}{baseline}{diamond centre y}
\newcommand{\dndSpell}[3]{%
  \dndFR{dnd@s#1@a}{18.3}{#2}{19bp}%
  \dndFR{dnd@s#1@b}{43.1}{#2}{106bp}%
  \dndFR{dnd@s#1@c}{155.4}{#2}{28bp}%
  \dndFR{dnd@s#1@d}{189.4}{#2}{40bp}%
  \dndFR{dnd@s#1@f}{305.7}{#2}{84bp}%
  \ifcsname dnd@s#1@e\endcsname
    \def\dnd@dy{#3}%
    \edef\dnd@flags{\csname dnd@s#1@e\endcsname}%
    \expandafter\forcsvlist\expandafter\dnd@spellflag\expandafter{\dnd@flags}%
  \fi}
\newcommand{\dnd@spellflag}[1]{%
  \def\dnd@f{#1}%
  \def\dnd@C{C}\def\dnd@R{R}\def\dnd@M{M}%
  \ifx\dnd@f\dnd@C\dnd@dia{243.15}{\dnd@dy}{8.3}\fi
  \ifx\dnd@f\dnd@R\dnd@dia{264.84}{\dnd@dy}{8.3}\fi
  \ifx\dnd@f\dnd@M\dnd@dia{286.53}{\dnd@dy}{8.3}\fi}

\makeatother
